items.title: AI could cut banking industry's cost base by 20% - McKinsey's
items.snippet: AI could cut the banking industry's cost base by 20% or more, but most firms have so far only used the technology to boost individual employees' productivity, with negligible impact on the bottom line, according to a report from McKinsey's.
